canonicalMutationReview.registrationPolicy: Do not count mutants against source absent from the verification head; register after integration and require an executed exact-head kill.

postal: only X-Postal-Signature-256 may satisfy the SHA-256 production webhook verifier
legacy X-Postal-Signature SHA-1 alone cannot authenticate
a valid legacy signature cannot rescue an invalid SHA-256 signature
stronger authenticated lifecycle state cannot be overwritten by a later lower-rank event
BOUNCED cannot regress to DELAYED or SENT
payment: canonical payment truth digest must be recomputed rather than trusted from an edited summary
CLEARED_PAYMENT.evidenceRef must bind to the one canonical verified provider event
synthetic, sandbox, test-style, or subscription substitution cannot satisfy first-cash proof
required claim-boundary semantics cannot be forged or cross-bound from another payment summary
external acceptance or rejection customerRef must match the fulfilment customerRef
genome: cyclic dependency bundles cannot be routed to execution
duplicate capability IDs or canonical identities fail health closed
stale or future-dated corpus evidence fails health closed

truthRules: Zero-step jobs are environment startup failures, not source failures.
No mutation kill is counted unless mutated source executes and the intended test fails for the intended guard.
Exact-head proof is SHA-scoped and does not transfer to a later receipt commit.
Other night branches are inspected read-only and are never overwritten by this lane.
No commercial truth changes without durable real external evidence.
nextVerificationActions: Keep PR #321 draft until real step-level exact-head evidence exists.

Require exact-head PostgreSQL execution before concurrency claims and exact-head browser execution before browser-path claims.
